AckCondition.description: A condition an operator can acknowledge (LN-2).

oneOf.description: "The store is older than the system it describes, and I accept it as authoritative."

AllowDestination.description: AL-1: the destination is an exact DNS name or an IPv4 network.

oneOf.description:
An exact DNS name: permits TLS whose server name equals it, to an address the host resolver
returned for it (AL-4).
An IPv4 network in CIDR form: permits TCP to its addresses (AL-5).

AllowEntry.description: AL-1: a destination and a non-empty set of ports.

content_digest.description: `sha256:<hex>`; present once the artifact is materialised.

AsOf.description: The committed state an answer reflects (API-10): a store lineage and a commit sequence.

BackendIdentity.description:
What this backend *is*, recorded in the runtime manifest and in every snapshot manifest
(contract §26.2, IS-2): a snapshot is only restorable by a backend with an equivalent identity.

security_profile_id.description: Stable digest of the isolation profile (seccomp, cgroups, namespaces, uid policy, …).

oneOf.description: `operation.cancel`.
A containment operation on the same sandbox (CC-3).

CapabilityProfile.description:
What the backend declares it can do (contract §26.3). A request that needs an undeclared
capability is refused with `UNSUPPORTED` before BEGIN; it is never silently skipped (BK-5).

identifier_slots.description: Size of the identifier pool: how many generations can hold distinct identifiers at once (RS-3).

incremental_output.description: Reading captured output while an execution is in flight (OU-5).

pause_resume.description: Used only inside a snapshot; never caller-visible.

per_runtime_overhead_mib.description: Memory the runtime itself needs beyond guest memory; counted in admission (RS-1).

restore_reseeds_entropy.description: Whether a restore reseeds guest entropy (RE-7). Evidence only.

runtime_depends_on_image.description: Whether a running generation still depends on the image store after provisioning (IM-4).

runtime_depends_on_snapshot.description:
Whether a running generation still depends on files of the snapshot it was restored from
(RF-1). If it does, the snapshot stays referenced while the generation lives.

secret_injection.description: Delivery of secret material to a guest at execution time (§22).

stop_grace_ms.description: How long the backend lets a runtime end by itself before it ends it by force.

Cleanup.description: Whether what a `FAILED` or `CANCELLED` operation created is gone (OP-7, FS-8).

oneOf.description: Everything the operation created is proven removed.
A `FAILED` generation or an `INVALID` snapshot remains and holds its lease.

argv.description:
Executed directly: an argument vector, never a shell string (EX-1). Use
`["/bin/sh","-c","..."]` to opt into a shell *inside the guest*.

secret_env.description:
Environment variables whose values are delivered from the host's secret provider (§22).
Requires the `secret_injection` capability of the profile and of the backend.

ContainmentReason.description: Why the host is in `CONTAINMENT`. Reasons accumulate; the mode holds while any remains.

oneOf.description:
A mandatory startup check failed (configuration relation of §30, preflight, trust anchors).
Cleared only by fixing the cause and restarting.
The safety profile could not be loaded or validated at startup.
An ownership marker on disk is newer than the store (LN-2). Cleared by `host.acknowledge`.
The lifetime enforcer cannot be confirmed to be running (PD-4). Clears when it is seen again.

Cursor.description: A position in one store's history (ID-4): meaningful only with its lineage.

Effect.description:
What a terminal operation did (API-9). A caller may issue a *new* operation for the same intent
safely only after `NOT_APPLIED`.

EvidenceStatus.description: Whether the evidence attached to a terminal result is whole (contract OU-2).

FailureClass.description: Contract §10.5. The wire names are the SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE forms.

oneOf.description: Malformed; unknown field or method; bound exceeded; raw secret material.
Peer not authenticated or not enrolled.
The peer's role does not permit the method.
The safety profile forbids or caps the request. Never clamped.
Target absent or outside the caller's tags; `retry` for an unknown operation.
Illegal for the current state; sandbox busy; equal or stronger containment in flight.
Stale generation or revision precondition.
Same operation id, different request.
`issued_at` is outside the acceptance horizon.
Host capacity, quota or rate limit.
The host mode refuses this class of method.
A capability the backend, guest or host does not offer.
The target generation is quarantined.
A list cursor is older than the change retention window, or from another lineage.
Protocol major mismatch or framing violation, caller ↔ host or host ↔ guest.
Artifact or manifest digest mismatch; an input that fails the trusted-input rule.
Snapshot, image or guest agent incompatible with this host.
The operation's deadline passed.
Backend, guest or secret provider unavailable.
A mandatory isolation control was missing at launch or later.
The operation failed and what it created is not yet proven removed.
The operation ended `UNKNOWN`.
None of the above.

Generation.description: Monotonic per-sandbox incarnation counter (contract ID-1). Starts at 1; never reused.

HostChange.description: What the host changed for an operator method.

containment_reasons.description: Why the host is in `CONTAINMENT`, when it is.

features.description: Features this host offers. A request using an unlisted feature is refused (VR-3).

operations_in_flight.description: Operations that have not ended (what a drain waits for).

read_only_reason.description: Why the host is in `READ_ONLY`, when it is.

oneOf.description: From process start until startup recovery ends. No endpoint is open.
Recovery complete and every mandatory check passed.
An operator asked for it (planned restart): no new privilege, everything else served.

A mandatory check failed, the safety profile is invalid, or the store is older than the
system it describes: no new privilege, everything else served.
The store cannot be written or interpreted: reads only.

ImageRef.description:
Immutable execution identity. The alias is a *mutable human label* and is never sufficient
on its own (contract IM-1): `image_id` is the digest of the image manifest.

Issuer.description: Who caused an operation: an enrolled peer, or the host acting on an observation (OP-24).

changed_since.description: Return only records that changed after this position, including tombstones (API-11).

NetworkIntent.description: What connectivity a sandbox is given. Recorded on the generation; never widened afterwards.

oneOf.description: No network device exists in the guest.
Outbound TCP to listed destinations only, through the host's resolver and relay.

NetworkMode.description:
The mode vocabulary. Any other word is refused with `UNSUPPORTED` before the request is decoded
any further (§20.1, `api::command`): a mode this host does not know is a capability it does not
offer. A known mode that the backend does not support is `UNSUPPORTED` too, and one that the
safety profile does not list is `SAFETY_CONTROL_DENIED`.

oneOf.description: No network device exists in the guest.
Outbound TCP to listed destinations only, through the host's resolver and relay.

OperationResult.description: The typed result of an operation.

oneOf.description: BEGIN is durable; no step has run.
A step is declared or running.

Inherited from an earlier activation, or a step's outcome is uncertain: the host is
establishing the outcome.
The operation's effect is in place.
The effect is not in place.
Ended by `operation.cancel` or by a containment operation.
The effect may have happened and the host cannot establish it. Executions only.

OperationType.description:
The type of a durable operation. Every method that is not a read has one; `sandbox.fail`
exists only as an operation the host issues itself (OP-24) and is not a wire method.

OperationView.description: An operation as of the response (API-6). Terminal only if it ended within the caller's `wait`.

cleanup.description:
Present on a `FAILED` or `CANCELLED` operation (OP-7). Derived from committed state at the
time of the response, so it becomes `COMPLETE` when what the operation left is later removed.

profile_id.description: The safety profile the operation was admitted under (SP-2).

data_b64.description: Base64 of the kept bytes — binary-safe, and bounded by the run's output budget.

total_bytes.description: Bytes the workload produced (>= `kept_bytes` when truncated).

OutputChunk.description: A slice of one stream of an execution's stored output (OU-4).

eof.description: No stored byte follows this slice.

stored_bytes.description: Bytes stored for the stream, and bytes the workload produced (OU-2).

OutputStatus.description: State of one captured stream (contract OU-1, OU-2).

Page.description:
One page of a list (API-11). `items` are in ascending revision order. Continue from `next`; when
`more` is false, `next` is the position the listing is complete up to.

Page2.description:
One page of a list (API-11). `items` are in ascending revision order. Continue from `next`; when
`more` is false, `next` is the position the listing is complete up to.

Page3.description:
One page of a list (API-11). `items` are in ascending revision order. Continue from `next`; when
`more` is false, `next` is the position the listing is complete up to.

PortRange.description: One inclusive port range. `from` and `to` are 1..=65535 and `from <= to`.

ProcessIdentity.description:
Stronger-than-PID process identity (RC-1).

`(pid, start_time_ticks, boot_id)` is stable for the life of one process and cannot be
reproduced by a different process that merely reuses the pid.

ProfileId.description: Identity of the safety profile in force when an operation was admitted (SP-1, SP-2).

digest.description: sha256 of the exact bytes that were verified and parsed. This is the identity.

ProfileLimits.description: Ceilings (§9.4, "Items the profile sets"). Every one is finite (N9).

max_allowlist_entries.description: Most allowlist entries one sandbox may have (AL-1).

max_lifetime_secs.description: Longest sandbox lifetime a request may ask for (LT-1).

Refusal.description: `REFUSED {class, retry}` (API-5): nothing was applied, and nothing was recorded.

ReleaseMode.description: QR-2: what the operator asserts when releasing a quarantined generation.

oneOf.description:
"The generation's recorded resources belong to this host." The host tears them down and
verifies absence.
"Nothing remains." The host only verifies that nothing recorded for the generation exists.

authority.description:
Reserved for a signed decision (AU-11). A host that does not advertise `signed_decision`
refuses any request that carries it. It never ignores it.

issued_at.description:
When the caller first issued the request: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fff]Z`. Required wherever
`operation_id` is.

on_behalf_of.description: Opaque label; recorded and never compared.

operation_id.description:
Caller-generated idempotency identity. Required for every granting, containment and
operator method (INV-005).

owner_scope.description: Opaque owner scope (AU-7). Stored and compared for equality; never interpreted.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier with a major version, e.g. `acf.host/2`.

request_id.description: Caller correlation; echoed; never an identity.

retry.description:
"I already submitted this operation." If the host has no record the answer is `NOT_FOUND`;
the request is never treated as new.

wait_ms.description:
How long the caller is willing to wait for the operation to end before the host answers with
its current state (API-6). Capped at `wait_max`; absent means `wait_max`.

RequestedMode.description: The two modes an operator may ask for (§12.6). Every other mode is entered by the host itself.

mechanism.description: The mechanism that actually enforced it — never claim a stronger one than was applied.

violated.description: The limit was reached and enforced.

oneOf.description: The request was not accepted. No operation record, no reservation, no effect.
The request was accepted. A durable operation record exists.
A read, served from committed state.

as_of.description: The committed state this answer reflects. Absent only on a refusal that consulted no state.

oneOf.description: Restore in place: a **new generation** of the same sandbox (RE-3). Keeps the sandbox's expiry.
Restore as a brand-new sandbox, generation 1.

RunLimitsRequest.description:
Limits a caller may *ask for*. Anything omitted takes the profile default; anything above a
profile ceiling is refused (never silently clamped, N4).

cpu_usage_usec.description: Host-cgroup CPU time consumed by the VMM during the run (delta).

max_bytes.description: At most this many bytes (capped by the host).

offset.description: Byte offset into the stored output of the stream.

guest_duration_ms.description: In-guest duration and the in-guest containment mechanism are the guest's statements.

host_backstop_fired.description: The host's own deadline passed without a result and the host ended the runtime (EX-5).

note.description: Honest note when the status is `UNKNOWN` or the runtime was ended for infrastructure reasons.

runtime_ended.description: The runtime was ended by the host as part of this execution.

RunStatus.description:
Status of one execution (contract §18.2, "Run status"). A non-zero exit is a *result*, not an
operation failure: it is `EXITED` with its exit code.

oneOf.description: The command ended by itself with an exit code.
The command was ended by a signal.
The guest ended it at the guest deadline, or the host backstop fired.
The guest could not start it.
Ended by `operation.cancel` or by a containment operation.
No result could be obtained. Never reported as success or failure.

image.description: Image alias (the safety profile lists which are allowed). The resolved identity is recorded.

lifetime_secs.description:
Lifetime in seconds from creation (LT-1). Absent: the profile's default. Above the profile's
ceiling: refused, never clamped.

name.description: An alias, unique among the caller's own live sandboxes. Never an identity (ID-5).

SandboxResources.description: What a sandbox is *given*. Immutable for the life of a generation (NW-3, RS-4).

sandbox.description: Sandbox id **or** alias. Read-only lookups only.

SandboxTarget.description: The target token of a lifecycle-changing method (CC-2).

expected_generation.description: Must be the sandbox's current generation, or the request is refused with `REVISION_CONFLICT`.

if_revision.description: Optional stronger precondition: the sandbox's revision must equal this (§10.3).

expires_at.description: When the sandbox ends (LT-1), wall clock, for display. The host enforces the monotonic one.

notes.description: Honest caveats attached to this view (for example restore uniqueness).

revision.description: Commit sequence of the last change to the sandbox's caller-visible state (ID-3).

secret_bearing.description: Secret material was delivered to this generation (SC-5).

tags.description: Tags of the request that created the sandbox (AU-8).

SecretRef.description:
A secret named by reference (SC-1). The only shape a request may use: there is no field that
carries material, so raw material in a request cannot be expressed and is refused by the schema.

ref.description: Name of a secret the operator provisioned on the host. `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, 1..=64.

SideEffect.description:
Whether the failed step may already have changed host state (FS-2). The default is `Possible`:
a backend reports `None` only when it can rule out any change to the host.

oneOf.description: Failed before any mutation: the effect is definitely absent.
The mutation may or may not have happened. Must be settled by observation.

name.description: An alias, unique among the caller's own snapshots.

incompatible.description: Why this snapshot cannot be restored on this host as it is now (§21.6). Empty: compatible.

secret_refs.description: References of the secrets live in the sandbox at capture (SC-5). Never material.

Tags.description: `(peer_id, owner_scope)` of the request that created a record (AU-8).
